dct_title_s: Accumulated satellite-detected water extents in Gaborone, South East and Kgatleng Districts, Botswana as of 23 to 25 February 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250220BWA, GDACS ID: 1103128** This map illustrates the satellite-detected accumulated flood extent in Gaborone, South East District, Botswana, as observed from Planet imagery and very high-resolution Pleiades imagery acquired between 23 and 25 February 2025. Within the analyzed area of approximately 700 km², an estimated 30 km² appears to be affected by floodwaters. UNITAR-UNOSAT has identified around 900 potentially affected structures, along with 24 affected road segments and 10 affected bridges within the analyzed area. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
